Completed the predeclared 12-run controlled panel and all three timing-calibrated supplemental SyN fits. Fresh measured supplemental ratios are 1.080/0.979/1.146 on OASIS 11/15/13; the fixed timing-only rule selects supplemental 11 and 15 and original generous 13 (closer ratio 1.081). Selected same-budget raw Dice means: HalfFlow 0.413943, SyN 0.536940; HD95 5.253667 versus 4.862603 mm. These are descriptive observed-data results with one timing per configuration, not qualification estimates. All 12 SyN timed outputs fail the unchanged 0.2 mm brain inverse gate, despite passing sampled cell topology; all full-resolution SyN runs hit the finest-level cap. The three current HalfFlow maps remain byte-identical to historical selected outputs. No converged common-gate-valid strong reference is established.

Executed the sealed one-case fixed-forward inverse diagnostic without parameter search. OASIS 11-to-12 forward bytes remain unchanged; reverse correction reduces maximum common brain round trip from 0.435439 to 0.330683 mm, still failing. Raw Dice 0.490862->0.491053; HD95 unchanged 5.138588. Full-grid solve leaves 1,389 points above 1e-5 mm tolerance, maximum residual 0.152274 mm; 234,328/2,275,500 points use counted affine extension. Native original field round-trip maxima already exceed 0.2 mm. Retain this failed diagnostic and do not promote it. P02 remains doing; next reference work needs a separately declared converged fit and denser/bidirectional export investigation. Final report, plots and compact evidence are being archived. No fresh qualification data were used.
